inline_prompts:
You are given a permutation P = (P_1, P_2, \ldots, P_N) of (1, 2, \ldots, N). Takahashi can repeatedly perform the following operation on P (possibly zero times):  
- Choose an integer i satisfying 1 \leq i \leq N-1. Pay a cost of i, and swap P_i and P_{i+1}. It refers to the minimum total cost required to sort P in ascending order.  
Input  
The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:  
N  
P_1 P_2 \ldots P_N  
Output  
Print the total cost required to sort P in ascending order.  
Constraints  
- 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5  
- (P_1, P_2, \ldots, P_N) is a permutation of (1, 2, \ldots, N).  
- All input values are integers.
